experiment_data.hypothesis: LLaMA-3.1-8B on Wikipedia will yield K*=1 (scorer-controlled), consistent with all other models on Wiki. Combined with C4 K*=2 and arXiv K*=3, this completes a 3-domain profile showing the same monotonic domain ceiling pattern as Mistral.

metrics.key_finding: LLaMA-8B Wiki K*=1 confirmed. 3-domain profile complete: Wiki=1, C4=2, arXiv=3. 1v2 AUC=0.595 (<0.60), consistent with all other models on Wiki.
